success_contract.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, and leave it running.
required_artifacts: A host TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:6665 forwarded to the guest console
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully in the background
Port 6665 is reachable from the host via telnet
Connecting with telnet shows the guest login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only showing a boot command without runtime readiness
Only checking that a process exists without confirming telnet reachability
verification_plan: Inspect available files/tools to locate the ISO and QEMU binary
Launch QEMU with serial/console forwarding to host port 6665 in the background
Measure readiness by connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 and confirming the login prompt appears
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and background process
Receipt-backed evidence that 127.0.0.1:6665 is listening and reachable
Receipt-backed evidence from a telnet connection showing the login prompt
notes: Preserve the original user objective; do not stop at surrogate checks.

items: Start QEMU in background with telnet-accessible console on 127.0.0.1:6665
Block until the service is ready
Capture receipts proving telnet reaches the login prompt

model_notes.focus: Need receipt-backed runtime evidence before finalization.

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
ls -l /app/alpine.iso
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || true
command -v telnet || true
command -v nc || true
actions.reason: Locate the ISO and available runtime tools before launching QEMU.
